newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 389,600 MT were 15 percent below the previous week and one-fifth under the 4-week average.

Major increases for Japan (121,200 MT, includes 149,500 new sales, 28,300 cancellations), South Korea (100,000 MT), and Spain (93,600 MT, includes 5,100 new sales, 88,500 destination changes) were partly offset by decreases for unknown destinations (48,000 MT) and Hong Kong (15,000 MT).
Sales activity for the 1997/98 marketing year of 57,100 MT were primarily for unknown destinations (55,900 MT).

Exports of 682,000 MT were up 31 percent from the previous week, but down 5 percent from the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Japan (198,200 MT), Indonesia (94,100 MT), Spain (93,600 MT), and Taiwan (66,900 MT).
